title: Finite modules admit a finitely presented approximation with stable closed fibre
statement: Let $A$ be a valuation ring, meaning an integral domain whose fraction field $K$ has $a\in A$ or $a^{-1}\in A$ for every $a\in K^\times$; it is a local ring, with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A$. Let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of local rings ($\mathfrak m_A$ is the inverse image of the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_B$ of $B$) which is essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra], and let $N$ be a finite $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. There is a filtered system of finitely presented $B$-modules $N_\lambda$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] with surjective transition maps and colimit $N$ such that, for all sufficiently large $\lambda$, the map $N_\lambda/\mathfrak m_A N_\lambda\to N/\mathfrak m_A N$ induced by the colimit map $N_\lambda\to N$ is an isomorphism.
